_meta.purpose: Geographic regions of interest for stratified training sampling. Each ROI defines a lat/lon bbox; ticks falling inside get tagged with the ROI name and sampled at a target rate to counter the natural class imbalance (channel ticks dominate by ~95%).
_meta.lookup_rule: When a tick falls inside multiple bboxes, the SMALLER-AREA ROI wins (more specific). Currently this matters for barri_village ⊂ y_tip.
_meta.outlier_rejection: Per-ROI bboxes were computed from tick ranges with k=4 MAD rejection on lat/lon. Outlier ticks (likely OCR-poisoned readings) are listed per-ROI for traceability.

cairo_outflow.notes: Lake-like outflow region right outside Cairo. Wide-water hugging substrate.

nubia_village.notes: Village overlay region. HUD lat/lon often occluded by village sprite; heading detector is also prone to misreads here. KEEP uncertain ticks for training — perception-stress examples.

the_bend.notes: Main Sudan bend — Nile swings west then climbs east. Includes one human-noted turn-around inside the range. Sharp shore-tangent flips characteristic of tight bends.

y_tip.notes: Y-tip junction (the one branch on the Nile). Trains 'turn left at junction' under the strict-labeling rule. Overlaps with barri_village; lookup picks the smaller area.

barri_village.notes: Village overlay region inside the Y-tip area. Same village-occlusion characteristics as Nubia. Nested inside y_tip bbox; lookup priority must pick barri_village for ticks in the intersection.

lake_end.notes: Lake at the Nile origin (Lake Victoria region). Open-water terminal — shoreline circumnavigation pattern, no defined channel direction. The hardest topology for the current planner.
